assertions.name: habiro_pochhammer_reproduces_witness
assertions.source: Corrected (u;u)_m Pochhammer + denominator reproduces the witness-cited tr_M(p, q₀) to < 1e-6 — confirms the exact Habiro expansion the q-difference analysis is built on.

assertions.name: root_of_unity_spectrum_extracted
assertions.source: tr_M Fourier-evaluated at ζ_d for d=2..M; each ζ_d keeps only the m<d Habiro modes (the WRT truncation).

description: Solve the Habiro q-difference structure of Q_β by Fourier-evaluating the Markov trace tr_M at roots of unity. The Pochhammer basis (u;u)_m vanishes at primitive d-th roots of unity for d ≤ m, so ζ_d-evaluation truncates the Habiro sum to the first d modes — the modular-tensor / WRT truncation that diagonalises the shift σ_q in Habiro's q-difference equation (1−σ_q)F = δ(q;q)_∞. Tabulates the per-mode root-of-unity spectrum of tr_M(p), tr_M(n), Δtr_M and the bar-even/odd split (σ_q at d=2 = bar involution). Tests PR #1602's prediction that the physical content is bar-even. Exact symbolic; no fitting; spectral characterization, not closure.

root_of_unity_spectrum.note: cancelled denominator(p&n)=0 at ζ_4 — genuine pole of tr_M

spectral_facts.d2_note: Δtr_M = 0 exactly at the d=2 bar/charge-conjugation mode — proton & neutron traces identical in the lowest Fourier mode; the p/n difference lives in d≥3 modes only.
spectral_facts.d3_d6_note: period-3 resonance in the root-of-unity tower
spectral_facts.pole_note: D(u)=4u¹⁹(u²+1) vanishes at ζ_4=i while the numerator does not — a genuine pole of tr_M, a structural feature of the q-difference equation.

bar_symmetry_split.laurent_note: orders are FULL Laurent (negative powers / poles at u=0 included); bar map u↦1/u makes both parts Laurent, not Taylor
bar_symmetry_split.interpretation: bar-even = charge-conjugation-symmetric = physical; the mechanism that cancels the odd-order u¹ term PR #1602 identified in f

interpretation.method: Fourier/root-of-unity diagonalisation of the Habiro q-difference shift σ_q
interpretation.result: spectral characterization of tr_M and Δtr_M; narrows f to its bar-even root-of-unity-truncated component
